decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a roof extension with rear dormer window and a single roof light in the front roof slope, as shown on drawing numbers LR/6113/01 (Revision B), received 25 August 2006, is recommended for approval as by reason of its size, position and appearance, it would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front elevation of house.
